name: kdsign
caption:
KD SIGNS 🎮🏀 He was up 3-1 on us in the West finals. Weeks later, he signed with us.

• 2016: Kevin Durant joins our 73-win team
• 2 titles and 2 Finals MVPs (2017, 2018)
• 2017 playoffs: 28.5 PPG on 55.6% shooting
• 2019: Achilles injury in the Finals, then he leaves for Brooklyn
• Steph never left: 27.8 PPG through his first 10 games this season

Signing KD: right call or not? 👇

beats.head: KD SIGNS
beats.name: KD
beats.vo: Kevin Durant was up three games to one on us in the West finals. Weeks later, he signs with us.
beats.dlg: HE WAS UP 3-1 ON US...|THEN HE SIGNS WITH US.

beats.head: BACK-TO-BACK
beats.name: KD
beats.vo: Two titles. Two Finals MVPs. Twenty seventeen and twenty eighteen.

beats.head: PLAYOFF KD
beats.name: KD
beats.vo: His first playoff run with us: twenty-eight point five points a night, on fifty-five point six percent shooting.

beats.head: THEN HE LEFT
beats.name: KD
beats.vo: Then, in the twenty nineteen Finals, his Achilles tears. That summer, he leaves for Brooklyn.
beats.dlg: 2019: HURT IN THE FINALS.|THEN HE GOES TO BROOKLYN.

beats.head: STILL HERE
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: KD plays for Houston now. Steph never left: twenty-seven point eight a night through his first ten games.
beats.dlg: KD IS IN HOUSTON NOW.|STEPH: 27.8 PPG IN 10 GAMES

beats.head: RIGHT CALL?
beats.vo: Two rings, three years. Was signing KD the right call? Comment below.

facts.claim: OKC led the record 73-win Warriors 3–1 in the 2016 Western Conference Finals and lost in seven; Durant then signed with Golden State in 2016; 2 NBA titles and 2 Finals MVPs (2017, 2018); Achilles injury in the 2019 NBA Finals, then joined the Brooklyn Nets in 2019; Warriors 2016–2019; now with the Houston Rockets
